title: Reckless
author: Lauren Roberts
summary: The second book of the Powerless series. In a kingdom where those with powers rule over everyone else, a young woman who has no power but a lot of nerve is drawn further into court politics and danger.
readIf: you want to continue a quick YA romantasy with trials, banter and a slow love story.
skipIf: you have not read Powerless, which sets up the entire situation.

pairings.reason: The first book, which you need to read before this one.
A young-adult fantasy of a hidden heroine and a royal court filled with people who have unusual powers.
Another young-adult fantasy of brutal trials and a spy among the ruling class.
